When: our.jng.lvl1 == Strong AND their.jng.lvl1 != Strong AND our.laners_lvl1_strong > their.laners_lvl1_strong
Approximation: "Nearby laners" read as: more of our laners have Strong level 1 than theirs. Which side to invade is chosen on the card from the strong laners.

Live check: Both teams place heavy level-1 vision
Approximation: "No clear Lvl 1 edge" read as: level-1 edge within one champion either way.
A side = its side lane (top side = top lane, bot side = bot lane). "No priority" read as Weak, not Even.

When: our.timing == Early AND (our.bot.prio == Strong OR our.mid.prio == Strong)
Approximation: "High early score" is not checked separately; comp timing Early stands in for it.

Live check: We have more champions at the objective
Approximation: Only the spike half is read from the draft; the numbers half is a live check.
"After levels 2-3" is not checked; the draft's expected priority stands in for it.
"Comp clearly favours top side" read as: top priority Strong while bot is not.
"Likely to be ganked early" is not checked separately; every Weak lane counts.
On the post-draft card this reads as: our top matchup is expected to lose.

When: our.timing == Early AND our.mid.prio == Strong AND our.bot.prio == Strong

Live check: Enemy jungler shown on the other side
Approximation: The "or enemy jungler shown elsewhere" half is a live check.
On the post-draft card this reads as: we blinded a matchup-dependent pick.

When: ((our.sup.roam OR our.sup.laning == Weak) AND our.bot.laning != Strong) OR (their.dive_threats >= 2 AND our.botlane_peel == 0)
Approximation: Only the two warning cases are checked: a roaming or weak-laning support with an ADC that is not Strong in lane, or 2+ enemy dive threats with no bot-lane peel.
Enchanter read as: support's primary style is Protect the carry.
